#include "aes_aes.h"
#include <stdint.h>

uint8_t rj_xtime(uint8_t x) {
    return (x & 0x80) ? ((x << 1) ^ 0x1b) : (x << 1);
}

uint8_t gf_log(uint8_t x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    uint8_t log = 0;
    uint8_t g = 1;
    while (g != x) {
        g = rj_xtime(g) ^ g;
        log++;
        if (log == 255) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return log;
}

uint8_t gf_alog(uint8_t x) {
    x = x % 255;
    if (x == 0) {
        return 1;
    }
    uint8_t res = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < x; i++) {
        res = rj_xtime(res) ^ res;
    }
    return res;
}

uint8_t gf_mulinv(uint8_t x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    uint8_t logx = gf_log(x);
    uint8_t exponent = (255 - logx) % 255;
    return gf_alog(exponent);
}

uint8_t rj_sbox(uint8_t x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    uint8_t logx = gf_log(x);
    uint8_t inv = gf_alog(255 - logx);
    return inv ^ x;
}

void aes_subBytes(uint8_t *buf) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        buf[i] = rj_sbox(buf[i]);
    }
}

void aes_shiftRows(uint8_t *buf) {
    uint8_t t;
    t = buf[1];
    buf[1] = buf[5];
    buf[5] = buf[9];
    buf[9] = buf[13];
    buf[13] = t;
    
    t = buf[2];
    buf[2] = buf[10];
    buf[10] = t;
    t = buf[6];
    buf[6] = buf[14];
    buf[14] = t;
    
    t = buf[15];
    buf[15] = buf[11];
    buf[11] = buf[7];
    buf[7] = buf[3];
    buf[3] = t;
}

void aes_mixColumns(uint8_t *buf) {
    for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++) {
        uint8_t s0 = buf[col*4 + 0];
        uint8_t s1 = buf[col*4 + 1];
        uint8_t s2 = buf[col*4 + 2];
        uint8_t s3 = buf[col*4 + 3];
        
        uint8_t t0 = rj_xtime(s0 ^ s1) ^ s1 ^ s2 ^ s3;
        uint8_t t1 = rj_xtime(s1 ^ s2) ^ s2 ^ s3 ^ s0;
        uint8_t t2 = rj_xtime(s2 ^ s3) ^ s3 ^ s0 ^ s1;
        uint8_t t3 = rj_xtime(s3 ^ s0) ^ s0 ^ s1 ^ s2;
        
        buf[col*4 + 0] = t0;
        buf[col*4 + 1] = t1;
        buf[col*4 + 2] = t2;
        buf[col*4 + 3] = t3;
    }
}

void aes_addRoundKey(uint8_t *buf, uint8_t *key) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        buf[i] ^= key[i];
    }
}

void aes_expandEncKey(uint8_t *k, uint8_t *rc) {
    (void)k;
    (void)rc;
}

void aes256_encrypt_ecb(aes256_context *ctx, uint8_t k[32], uint8_t buf[16]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        ctx->key[i] = k[i];
    }
    
    uint8_t w[240];
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        w[i] = k[i];
    }
    
    const uint8_t Rcon[14] = {
        0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x20, 0x40, 0x80, 0x1b, 0x36,
        0x6c, 0xd8, 0xab, 0x4d
    };
    
    int i = 8;
    while (i < 60) {
        uint8_t temp[4];
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            temp[j] = w[(i-1)*4 + j];
        }
        
        if (i % 8 == 0) {
            uint8_t t0 = temp[0];
            temp[0] = temp[1];
            temp[1] = temp[2];
            temp[2] = temp[3];
            temp[3] = t0;
            
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                temp[j] = rj_sbox(temp[j]);
            }
            
            temp[0] ^= Rcon[i/8 - 1];
        }
        else if (i % 8 == 4) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                temp[j] = rj_sbox(temp[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            w[i*4 + j] = w[(i-8)*4 + j] ^ temp[j];
        }
        i++;
    }
    
    aes_addRoundKey(buf, w);
    
    for (int round = 1; round < 14; round++) {
        aes_subBytes(buf);
        aes_shiftRows(buf);
        aes_mixColumns(buf);
        aes_addRoundKey(buf, &w[round * 16]);
    }
    
    aes_subBytes(buf);
    aes_shiftRows(buf);
    aes_addRoundKey(buf, &w[14 * 16]);
}

uint8_t rj_xtime(uint8_t x) {
